clips.title: The story
paras: Strahad Farsan is a master human warlock who dwells in a secluded stone tower overlooking Ratchet in the Barrens. Renowned across faction lines, he operates outside conventional Alliance and Horde politics, training aspiring summoners in the dangerous arts of binding higher demons. Practitioners of fel magic from Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and the Undercity alike seek his severe guidance.

Perched on the bluffs above the goblin port of Ratchet, Strahad Farsan's tower stands apart from the bustling trade docks below. Ratchet's neutrality offers Strahad the freedom to conduct perilous demonic summonings away from the prying eyes of Alliance magistrates or Horde shamans. Surrounded by his acolytes, he studies the deeper mysteries of the Twisting Nether in relative seclusion, unbothered by petty territorial squabbles.

Strahad earned his formidable reputation through direct, deadly experience. When first binding a felhunter into service, he barely escaped with his life—an ordeal that left him both acutely cautious and unyielding in his expectations. Despite his human heritage, he has earned the respect of shadowy figures across Azeroth, including Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind and demonic scholars in the Undercity and Orgrimmar. Warlocks of any banner who wish to command creatures as volatile as felhunters or fiery steeds are inevitably directed to his doorstep.
